name: worker_process_lifecycle

test_list.description: The worker's final Tokio runtime wait returns within its configured bound while an already-started blocking task remains gated, without claiming that task was preempted.

inputs.name: grace
inputs.description: Maximum time the process waits for already-started blocking tasks after asynchronous service shutdown.

inputs.name: blocking_task
inputs.description: A non-preemptible task that may continue in the background after the shutdown wait expires.

output_description: The worker bounds runtime-drop waiting but does not claim to cancel in-process blocking work; process termination remains the final isolation boundary.
